name: Model Evaluator
description: ML model assessment covering classification metrics (precision, recall, F1, AUC-ROC), regression metrics (MAE, RMSE, R2), confusion matrix analysis, cross-validation strategies, bias detection, fairness metrics, and A/B testing for models. Use when the user asks about model evaluator, model evaluator best practices, or needs guidance on model evaluator implementation. Do NOT use when the user needs a different specialized skill or is asking about an unrelated technology domain.
